intro: Minneapolis has one of the deepest public-sauna scenes in the US: hosted wood-fired saunas parked beside city lakes, a classic communal bathhouse, and several newer sauna-and-cold-plunge clubs. Several lake saunas are seasonal or move between park permits, so always check the booking page before you go.

venues.name: FoxFire Breathworks (Lake Nokomis & Bde Maka Ska)
venues.neighborhood: Lake Nokomis (north parking lot near the kayak launch) and Bde Maka Ska
venues.cold_plunge: Lake (40-65°F depending on season, per venue)
venues.schedule: Mixed public sessions; 18+ for individual sign-ups (13+ with an adult). Fall hours: Wed (Nokomis only), Fri 4:30/6:00/7:30 PM; Sat-Sun 9:00 & 10:30 AM, 4:00/6:00/7:30 PM. Hours change seasonally.
venues.notes: Hosted; up to 8 people at Nokomis and 10 at Bde Maka Ska. Operates on Minneapolis Parks permits.

venues.name: Little Ember Co (Cedar Lake)
venues.schedule: Mixed community sessions. Seasonal: Thursday-Sunday, November-March.
venues.notes: Two wood-fired saunas, up to 10 per session, host on site. Nearest restroom is the next beach over, so arrive in your swimsuit.

venues.name: 612 Sauna Cooperative
venues.schedule: Mixed community sessions, plus special sessions (silent, Aufguss, BIPOC, LGBTQIA+, larger bodies) at varying prices.
venues.notes: Member-owned co-op. Host on hand at every session.

venues.name: Watershed Spa
venues.schedule: Communal, gender-inclusive per secondary source; 18+. Open daily 9 AM-11 PM (last entry 9 PM).
venues.notes: Also has a hot soaking pool and rest area.

venues.name: PORTAL° Thermaculture Minneapolis
venues.schedule: Mixed; 18+. Sun 8 AM-10 PM, Mon-Wed 6 AM-10 PM, Thu 12-10 PM, Fri-Sat 8 AM-11 PM.
venues.notes: Unlimited membership $179/month. Venue site does not say how many credits one session costs.

venues.name: Embrace North (Marcy Holmes)
venues.drop_in_price: Unknown (shown only in the venue's app)
venues.notes: Three saunas. Booking is through the Embrace North app; first-timers get two complimentary sessions per the venue.

venues.name: All's Well Sauna and Waterspa
venues.schedule: Unknown. Open 3-10 PM weekdays, 10 AM-10 PM weekends.
venues.notes: Social spa with warm pool and salt room. Free parking in surrounding lots.
